_comment_mail: How long an unread mail in importantMailbox stays on the wall, counted from when it arrived. personMailMinutes is for mail a person wrote. automatedMailMinutes is for mail a machine sent: confirmations, receipts, reminders, codes, invitations, newsletters. Opening a mail takes it down sooner. Texts go by voiceDisplayMinutes instead.
_comment_voice: voiceMaxAgeMinutes is how far back to scan; voiceDisplayMinutes is how long a text stays on the wall. Only the second decides when a card disappears.
_comment_packages: packageMailbox 'All Mail' still contains archived mail, so archiving an order will not clear its card. Set it to 'INBOX' if you want archiving to be how you dismiss a package.
